title: City of Laredo Utilities Department is hiring
excerpt: The City of Laredo Utilities Department is looking to add to its team, inviting people who want to learn new skills and serve the community to apply online.
content:
The City of Laredo Utilities Department is hiring, and it is inviting people who want to learn new skills, grow professionally and serve the community to consider joining its team.

The department runs the city's water and wastewater systems, and its employees keep those systems operating every day, the department said in a post shared Wednesday, Nov. 12, 2026.

Anyone interested can see the open positions and apply online at www.laredocityjobs.com. The post did not list specific job titles.

Source: City of Laredo Utilities Department (Facebook), Nov. 12, 2026.
